# Vendored dependencies

- `bcdec/`: BC1–BC7 texture decoding; license in `bcdec/LICENSE`.
- `ryujinx/`: the Ryujinx 1.3.2 shader translation subset; license in `ryujinx/LICENSE.txt`, with the Spv.Generator notice retained in its directory.

Only dependencies used by the Android runtime or its offline shader translator are retained. See [third-party notices](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for attribution and the other code incorporated outside this directory.
